question: Who among the following is the first table tennis player to win the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manika Batra**__.

__
 
• **Manika Batra is the first table tennis player to win the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manika Batra** an Indian table tennis player hails from Narain Vihar, Delhi.

 
 
• She is the top-ranked table tennis player in India and ranked 50th in the world as of February 2022.
 
• Other Awards: Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Poulomi Ghatak** an Indian table tennis player hails from West Bengal India who won three national junior champions**.**
 
• **Soumyajit Ghosh **an Indian table tennis player hails from West Bengal India** **is the youngest player to qualify for London 2012 Olympics**.**
 
• **Sharath Kamal **an Indian table tennis player hails from Tamil Nadu was awarded Padma Shri in the year 2019.
 
 
• ​He was the first Indian table tennis player to become nine times senior national champion.
 
• He also received Arjuna Award in the year 2004.
 
 

6c
